LanguageData.Taggerung_IAintBuildingThat_ShowHiddenBu: When enabled disables the button hiding.
LanguageData.Taggerung_IAintBuildingThat_EnableAbilit: When disabled, the ability hiding feature is turned off entirely: hidden abilities reappear and the hide/restore option is removed from ability right-click menus.
LanguageData.Taggerung_IAintBuildingThat_RevealComboT: While these keys are held, hidden buildings and abilities are temporarily shown. Defaults to Ctrl + Alt. Tick no keys to disable hold-to-reveal.
LanguageData.Taggerung_IAintBuildingThat_MenuComboToo: When any key is ticked, the hide/restore right-click menu only appears while those keys are held; a plain right-click then passes through to the game or other mods (fixing conflicts such as mechanoid upgrade turret auto-use toggles). Tick no keys to always show the menu on right-click.
